children: Darling Ingredients’ third-quarter sales and earnings rose from a year earlier, supported by stronger fat and protein prices and higher margins in Feed Ingredients, as well as increased production and sales, higher RIN values and diesel prices at Diamond Green Diesel. Food Ingredients benefited from stronger collagen demand, partly offset by higher raw-material costs and tariffs.
¹ Reported as “Total net sales”. ² Reported as “Net income attributable to Darling”. ³ Reported as “Diluted income per share”.
: Operating income rose 66.8% to $150.8M as fat and protein prices, product quality and sales into higher-margin markets lifted gross margin to 27.7%.
: Operating income increased 7.2% to $44.8M on stronger market demand and sales volumes; gross margin fell to 26.5% amid higher raw-material costs and tariffs.
: Operating income reached $180.3M, up 691.1%, as DGD production and sales volumes, RIN values and diesel prices increased.
: Feed Ingredients processed approximately 3.19 million metric tons of raw material, up 1.0%; Food Ingredients processed approximately 316,000 metric tons, up 0.6%.
